news.analysis: Burrow and the Cincy offense got off to a slow start on a rainy night at Northwest Stadium as they didn't score their first points until the second quarter. His first touchdown pass went to Tee Higgins in the second quarter, while his second was a four-yard completion to Colbie Young in the third. The game on Monday night was the first time Burrow didn't throw for at least three touchdowns since Week 4 vs. Jacksonville. He will be a top-three fantasy QB in Week 12 against the Saints.
news.contents: Joe Burrow completed 28 of his 40 passes for 300 yards and two touchdowns in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11.
news.title: Joe Burrow throws two TDs in Week 11 loss

news.contents: Cincinnati Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow had a solid game with exactly 300 passing yards and two passing touchdowns, but it wasn't enough to get the win on a rainy night in Washington, D.C. The Commanders rallied back with five second-half field goals to get the win on Monday Night Football, snapping Cincinnati's five-game winning streak.
